title: Holidays
about: Words for holidays: types of holidays, ways to travel and things to take with you. Also useful expressions like 'Have a great time!' and 'Send me a postcard!'

items.pattern: have a (lovely / great / good) holiday · had a holiday in + place
items.meaning: spend some free days away from work or school, often in another place
items.example: We **had a great holiday** in Croatia with our cousins.
more: Did you **have a good holiday**? You look really happy!
My grandparents **had a holiday** by the sea in May.
items.watchOut: Відпочити у відпустці — have a holiday, а не make a holiday чи do a holiday. У британській англійській holiday — і відпустка дорослих, і канікули дітей (в американській частіше vacation).

items.pattern: be on holiday · I'm on holiday next week
items.meaning: not at work or school because you are having a holiday
items.example: Our teacher **is on holiday**, so we've got a different teacher this week.
more: Sorry, the shop is closed. The owners **are on holiday**.
I can't come to your party. I'll **be on holiday** in Italy.
items.watchOut: Прийменник — on: on holiday. Не in holiday і не at holiday.

items.pattern: go on holiday (to + place) · went on holiday
items.meaning: leave home and travel somewhere for a holiday
items.example: We **go on holiday** to the mountains every winter.
more: When are you **going on holiday**?
Who looks after your cat when you **go on holiday**?
items.watchOut: Поїхати у відпустку — go on holiday, а не go to holiday. To ставимо перед місцем: go on holiday to Spain.

items.pattern: a package holiday (to + place) · go on a package holiday
items.meaning: a holiday where you buy the flights and the hotel together, for one price
items.example: We booked a **package holiday** to Turkey, so we didn't plan anything.
more: A **package holiday** is easy for families with small children.
My aunt goes on a **package holiday** to Greece every year.
items.watchOut: «Пакет» тут — package, а не packet (packet — пачка, пакетик: a packet of crisps). Кажуть також a package tour.

items.pattern: a flight (to + place) · a long / short flight · our flight leaves at …
items.meaning: a journey on a plane
items.example: The **flight** to London was only three hours.
more: I watched two films on the long **flight**.
Our **flight** leaves at ten, so we must get up early.
items.watchOut: Flight — подорож літаком або рейс, а не сам літак (a plane). Летіти — fly.

items.pattern: a winter holiday · go on a winter holiday
items.meaning: a holiday in winter, often in the snow
items.example: We're going on a **winter holiday** in the mountains. I want to learn to ski.
more: On our **winter holiday**, we built a big snowman.
Take warm boots on your **winter holiday**!
items.watchOut: Шкільні зимові канікули частіше називають the Christmas holidays (множина). A winter holiday — це поїздка на відпочинок узимку.

items.pattern: go camping · went camping · a camping holiday
items.meaning: have a holiday where you sleep in a tent
items.uk: поїхати (піти) в похід з наметом, відпочивати в наметі
items.example: We **went camping** by a lake. At night we heard frogs.
more: Do you want to **go camping** with us in August?
It rained all week when we **went camping**, but it was fun.
items.watchOut: Go camping — без to: go camping, а не go to camping. Так само go swimming, go shopping.

items.pattern: a walking holiday (in + place) · go on a walking holiday
items.meaning: a holiday when you walk a lot every day, often in hills or mountains
items.example: On our **walking holiday**, we walked fifteen kilometres a day.
more: You need comfortable shoes for a **walking holiday**.
My parents are going on a **walking holiday** in Scotland.

items.pattern: a coach tour (of + place) · go on a coach tour
items.meaning: a holiday when you travel from place to place in a big comfortable bus
items.example: We saw five cities in a week on our **coach tour**.
more: On a **coach tour**, you can sleep between the cities.
Grandma loves **coach tours** because she doesn't have to drive.
items.watchOut: Coach — великий зручний автобус для далеких поїздок, bus — зазвичай міський автобус. Тому автобусний тур — a coach tour.

items.pattern: go / travel / come by plane
items.meaning: in a plane
items.example: It's quicker to go to Spain **by plane**.
more: My cousin came from Canada **by plane**.
Do you like travelling **by plane**?
items.watchOut: Літаком — by plane, без артикля: не by the plane і не with plane. Можна сказати й одним словом: We flew to Spain.

items.pattern: go / travel by train
items.meaning: in a train
items.example: We went to the seaside **by train** and read books on the way.
more: It takes two hours **by train**.
I go to my grandma's **by train** every summer.
items.watchOut: Поїздом — by train, а не with train. On the train — це «у поїзді»: I slept on the train.

items.pattern: go / travel by car
items.meaning: in a car
items.example: We went to France **by car**, so we took lots of bags.
more: The farm is only twenty minutes away **by car**.
Is it far **by car**?
items.watchOut: Машиною — by car, без артикля. Але з my / our / Dad's — in: We went in Dad's car.

items.pattern: go / travel by ferry · take the ferry
items.meaning: on a big boat that takes people and cars across the sea or a river
items.example: We crossed to the island **by ferry** and saw dolphins.
more: It's two hours **by ferry** from here.
Going **by ferry** is slow, but you can walk around on the boat.
items.watchOut: Ferry /ˈferi/ — пором. Не плутай з fairy /ˈfeəri/ — фея.

items.pattern: go / travel by coach
items.meaning: in a big comfortable bus for long journeys
items.example: Going to Edinburgh **by coach** is cheaper than by train.
more: We travelled **by coach** to the football match.
Our school trip to the museum is **by coach**.
items.watchOut: Coach читається /kəʊtʃ/ — «коуч». Це також тренер у спорті, тож дивись на контекст.

items.pattern: a passport · show your passport
items.meaning: a small book with your photo and name that you need to travel to another country
items.example: Please show your **passport** at the airport.
more: My little brother got his first **passport** for our trip to Poland.
Keep your **passport** in a safe place.
items.watchOut: Закордонний паспорт англійською — просто passport. Наголос на першому складі: PASS-port.

items.pattern: a visa · get / need a visa
items.meaning: a stamp or paper in your passport that says you can go into a country
items.example: Dad got a **visa** for his work trip to India.
more: How long does it take to get a **visa**?
My aunt is still waiting for her **visa** for Canada.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈviːzə/ — «ві-за», з довгим «і» і дзвінким /z/.

items.pattern: a ticket · a train / plane / bus ticket · a ticket to + place
items.meaning: a piece of paper or a message on your phone that shows you paid for a journey
items.example: Mum bought the train **tickets** online.
more: How much is a **ticket** to Lviv?
I can't find my **ticket**! Is it in your bag?
items.watchOut: Квиток до Львова — a ticket to Lviv, а не a ticket on Lviv чи in Lviv.

items.pattern: currency · the local currency · change money into the local currency
items.meaning: the money of a country
items.example: Before the trip, Dad bought some **currency** at the bank.
more: Each country has its own **currency**.
We spent all our **currency** on ice cream and presents!
items.watchOut: Наголос на першому складі: /ˈkʌrənsi/ — «КА-рен-сі».

items.pattern: a camera · take photos with a camera
items.meaning: a thing you take photos with
items.example: Grandpa takes his old **camera** on every holiday.
more: Smile at the **camera**, everybody!
I left my **camera** on the beach! Can we go back?
items.watchOut: Наголос на першому складі: KAM-ra. Фотографувати — take photos, а не make photos.

items.pattern: luggage (uncountable) · a lot of luggage · a piece of luggage
items.meaning: the bags and suitcases you take on a journey
items.example: We've got too much **luggage**! It won't go in the car.
more: Wait for your **luggage** here after the flight.
Can you help me with my **luggage**? It's very heavy.
items.watchOut: Luggage — незлічуваний іменник: much luggage, a lot of luggage. Не кажуть a luggage чи luggages. Одна валіза — a piece of luggage або a bag.

items.pattern: a suitcase · pack / unpack a suitcase
items.meaning: a big bag with a handle, often with wheels, for your clothes when you travel
items.example: My **suitcase** has wheels, so it's easy to pull.
more: Help me close this **suitcase**. It's too full!
Pack your **suitcase** tonight. We leave at six.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈsuːtkeɪs/ — «сут-кейс», перше u довге, як у soup.

items.pattern: a rucksack · carry a rucksack on your back
items.meaning: a bag that you carry on your back
items.example: I carry my water and sandwiches in my **rucksack**.
more: This **rucksack** is too heavy for a long walk.
Put your jacket in your **rucksack**.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈrʌksæk/ — «рак-сак», не «рюк-зак». Кажуть також backpack.

items.pattern: fly to + place · fly from A to B · flew · flown
items.meaning: travel by plane
items.example: We're **flying** to Rome next month.
more: Are you **flying**, or are you going by train?
My grandparents **flew** from London to Dublin.
items.watchOut: Минулий час — flew, а не flied. «Летіти літаком» — просто fly, без by plane.

items.pattern: try the local food / dishes
items.meaning: eat the usual food of a place, often for the first time
items.example: In Japan, I **tried the local food** and loved the noodles.
more: Let's **try the local food** tonight, not pizza again!
I always **try the local food** when I'm on holiday.
items.watchOut: Скуштувати, спробувати — try, а не test (test — перевіряти, контрольна).

items.pattern: enjoy the nightlife · the nightlife is great / quiet
items.meaning: have fun in a town in the evening and at night: music, cafés, lights and busy streets
items.example: Our hotel is in the centre, so we can **enjoy the nightlife**: street music, lights and ice cream.
more: Big cities are great if you **enjoy the nightlife**.
In summer, the streets are full of people, and everybody **enjoys the nightlife**.
items.watchOut: Nightlife — одне слово і незлічуване: the nightlife, без -s.

items.pattern: Have a great / good / nice time! · have a great time at / in …
items.meaning: we say this to someone who is going on holiday or to a party: I hope you enjoy it
items.example: 'We're going to Paris tomorrow!' '**Have a great time!**'
more: '**Have a great time** at the party!' said Mum.
Bye, everyone! **Have a great time** at the summer camp!
items.watchOut: Гарно провести час — have a good / great time, а не spend a good time чи make a good time.

items.pattern: send sb a postcard · send a postcard to sb
items.meaning: post a card with a picture of a place on it to someone
items.example: I **sent my grandma a postcard** from the seaside.
more: Don't forget to **send us a postcard**!
She **sends a postcard** to her best friend from every city.
items.watchOut: Два порядки слів: send me a postcard або send a postcard to me. Не send to me a postcard.

warmup.explain: У відпустці, на канікулах — on holiday.

warmup.uk: Ти поїдеш кудись відпочивати цього літа?
warmup.q: Are you going ___ holiday with your parents in August?
warmup.explain: Поїхати у відпустку — go on holiday, без to.

warmup.uk: Ми купили пакетний тур до Єгипту.
warmup.q: We bought a ___ holiday to Egypt.
warmup.explain: Пакетний тур — package holiday. Packet — пачка, пакетик.

warmup.uk: Минулого літа ми їздили в похід з наметом.
warmup.explain: Go camping — без прийменника, як go swimming.
Вид транспорту — by + слово без артикля: by ferry, by train.

warmup.q: We want to ___ the local food.

warmup.explain: Так кажуть тому, хто їде відпочивати: Have a great time!

A.q: Did you ___ a nice holiday in Greece?
Every August, my family ___ on holiday to the seaside.
A.explain: Поїхати у відпустку — go on holiday.

A.q: Don't call me at the office this week. I'm on ___ at the beach.
A.explain: Бути у відпустці — be on holiday.

B.q: We slept in a tent by the river. We went ___.
The price included the hotel and the flights. It was a ___ holiday.
B.explain: Переліт і готель разом за одну ціну — package holiday.

B.q: We visited eight towns in a big comfortable bus. It was a ___.
B.explain: Поїздка великим автобусом з міста в місто — coach tour.

C.q: We went ___ and saw dolphins swimming next to the boat.
C.explain: Човен, море, дельфіни — пором: by ferry.

C.q: Dad drove all the way to Italy. We went ___.
C.explain: Тато сам вів машину — by car.

C.q: The station is near our hotel, so we're going ___.

D.q: I can't go into the country without a ___ in my passport.
D.explain: Дозвіл у паспорті на в'їзд до країни — visa.

D.q: Dollars, euros and pounds are different kinds of ___.
I carry everything on my back in a ___.
D.explain: Сумка, яку носять на спині, — rucksack.

E.q: 'What are you going to do in Rome?' 'We want to ___ the local food.'
E.explain: Скуштувати місцеву їжу — try the local food.

E.q: Grandma got a ___ from us with a photo of the beach on it.
Bye! ___ a great time at the camp!
E.explain: Гарно провести час — have a great time.

example.title: A week in Greece
example.uk:
У липні Софія з батьками поїхала у відпустку до Греції. Вони летіли літаком, і переліт тривав лише три години. Софія несла свій рюкзак, а тато котив велику валізу.

Потім вони попливли поромом на маленький острів. Там вони скуштували місцеву їжу. Софії дуже сподобався пиріг із сиром! Увечері вони насолоджувалися нічним життям: музика, вогні й морозиво на площі.

В останній день Софія надіслала найкращій подрузі листівку. «Я чудово проводжу час!» — написала вона.
example.en:
In July, Sofia and her parents [[went on holiday|a3]] to Greece. They went [[by plane|c1]], and the [[flight|b2]] was only three hours. Sofia carried her [[rucksack|d8]], and Dad pulled a big [[suitcase|d7]].

Then they went to a small island [[by ferry|c4]]. There they [[tried the local food|e2]]. Sofia loved the cheese pie! In the evening, they [[enjoyed the nightlife|e3]]: music, lights and ice cream in the square.

On the last day, Sofia [[sent her best friend a postcard|e5]]. 'I'm [[having a great time|e4]]!' she wrote.
